mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.reference_no, t.user_id, t.wallet_id, t.type, t.direction, t.status, t.amount, t.fee_amount, t.currency_code, t.category_id, t.counterparty_user_id, t.recipient_id, t.counterparty_name, t.counterparty_account_no, t.related_transaction_id, t.idempotency_key, t.note, t.occurred_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at, c.id AS cat_id, c.code AS cat_code, c.type AS cat_type, c.name AS cat_name, c.icon AS cat_icon, c.color AS cat_color, c.sort_order AS cat_sort_order FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions ( reference_no, user_id, wallet_id, type, direction, status, amount, fee_amount, currency_code, category_id, counterparty_user_id, recipient_id, counterparty_name, counterparty_account_no, related_transaction_id, idempotency_key, note, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{referenceNo}, #{userId}, #{walletId}, #{type}, #{direction}, #{status}, #{amount}, #{feeAmount}, #{currencyCode}, #{categoryId}, #{counterpartyUserId}, #{recipientId}, #{counterpartyName}, #{counterpartyAccountNo}, #{relatedTransactionId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{note}, #{occurredAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.icon AS category_icon, c.color AS category_color, SUM(t.amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type = 'expense' AND t.status = 'success' AND t.occurred_at >= #{start} AND t.occurred_at < #{end} AND t.wallet_id = #{walletId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.color ORDER BY amount DESC, c.id ASC
